title: Rabbi Chanin, Son-in-Law of the Patriarch’s House
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Moed Katan 25a (25b in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.25b.9) relates that he had no children. He prayed for mercy and had a son. On the day his wife gave birth, he died, and they named his son Chanin after his father.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names the father Rabbi Chanin and the child Chanan. Hyman gives Chanin for the child and cites 25a.
[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1396&lang=en) gives Chanan for the child and cites 25b. It titles the father Rav Chanin.
